items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Premium Demand and Pricing Power Support Growth Despite Fuel Risks
items.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc.’s (NYSE:DAL) results exceeded management’s guidance for the June quarter. Premium products and diversified, high-margin revenue streams accounted for 61% of the company’s adjusted operating revenue. items.title: Polymarket Names First CFO; Macy’s Bets on Pricier Products
items.summary: Polymarket named Warren Jenson as its first companywide CFO, who joins at a pivotal time as the company looks to expand its market share.  Jenson has a long track record in finance and previously served as finance chief of Amazon, Electronic Arts, Delta Air Lines and NBC during the ’90s and early 2000s, my colleague Katherine Hamilton reports.  Most recently, he was CFO at Nielsen, which he left in January 2025.

items.title: Airfares Are Getting Silly. But Airline Stocks Are Set to Take Off.
items.summary: Airfares are getting ridiculous.  Airline stocks have struggled in recent weeks as oil prices have climbed back above $100 a barrel.  With airlines significantly hiking airfares in August, it suggests the largest U.S. carriers are well-placed to mitigate much of the increase in fuel costs.
